newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 1.05 million barrels in the week ended April 4 to 309.95 million barrels from 308.90 million in the prior week, American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 455,000 barrels in the week to 245.95 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 1.04 million barrels to 98.39 million barrels from 99.43 million the prior week.
PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.08 million barrels to 30.45 million barrels.
Gasoline production rose 632,000 barrels in the week to 7.67 million bpd from 7.04 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 1.22 million barrels in the week to 195.99 million barrels from a revised 197.21 million barrels that was previously reported as 198.21 million.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 94.3 percent from 93.6 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 43,000 barrels to 34.95 million barrels from a revised 34.90 million barrels that was previously reported as 35.91 million the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.34 million barrels from 14.29 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 39.75 million barrels from 39.86 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 8.33 million barrels per day from 8.02 million.
